name: Hero
description: the hero: an armoured knight in battered dark bronze plate armour with brass trim, a closed helm with two glowing orange eye slits, tattered maroon cloth hanging from the belt, heavy gauntlets and greaves; broad, tired, unimpressed posture; his gun from the start is a huge rocket launcher with glowing orange chambers; exactly the look of his existing Idle sprite (SickOfItGamePlayer/Idle)
notes: Hero clips (Docs/ArtPipeline.md, 'Hero clips'). The hero is the ARMOURED KNIGHT (SickOfItGamePlayer/Idle), never a man in a jacket. Every grip (content/weapons hands) has its own set: a carry pose made from Idle's first frame with the weapon's concept (pose weapon<Grip>, image.generate) as image 2, then Idle/Run/Jump/Fall/Attack copied from his launcher videos' motion (video.animate, 'motion': 'player:<State>'), so every set has the launcher's timing, size and ground line; the rest are first-last-frame clips (video.i2v). Shared moves (dash, walls, the hook, graze, hurt, deaths, victory, ladders) show him with empty hands, one look for every grip. 1280x720 frames baked to 604x340 cells at 100 PPU (Idle's size). 'wired' says what player.json does: 'own', 'standIn' or false. Ledge grab/climb: no such mechanic in the game yet.
